snippet.title: DynamoKid Touch
snippet.description:
With Dynamo Kid Touch we bring our most favorite game character into the world of touch-screen devices. We love our old school platform gameplay, and with this game we try to prove that with a new control-scheme you can still recreate the best elements of good platform games.

The game is available for Android and iPhone / iPod touch devices

http://orangepixel.net/dynamokid
